name: Portals - N portals then exit
description: Runs a set number of portals, then clicks Exit to Lobby. Workflow: open your preferred portal manually (Items -> Portals tab -> click portal), press Play, and the macro takes over from the Activate screen. Every post-run chooser increments a counter (the Detect block inside Loop A, mode='counter'); THEN fires (Select next portal) while count <= limit, ELSE fires (Exit to Lobby) once count > limit. Run from a Portals task (0.22) and the count comes from that task's "Portals Then Exit" field automatically -- the counter Detect carries limit_from_task='extract_after', and 0 there means keep going until you stop the task. Run it from the Macro Manager instead (no task) and it falls back to the `limit` baked into that block: edit it for any positive integer (default 3), or leave it empty ('') for infinite. Post-run Select always accepts whichever of the 3 portals the game offered -- no branching needed. Coords come from Settings > Debug > Macro Coordinates.
